description: Convert a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML or TXT file to Markdown. Give either `url` (a public link to the file) or `content_base64` plus `filename`. Scanned PDF pages are read by an AI vision model. `ai_accuracy` (paid plans) reads every PDF page with AI for exact tables. Each call uses one conversion.
name: convert_document
title: Convert a document to Markdown
